# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_GAP_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In low-volatility regimes (VIX < 12), SPY opening gaps tend to exhibit mean reversion within the first hour, creating an edge for fading the initial gap direction via a long entry after a partial gap retracement. This edge exists because low VIX environments often lack follow-through momentum, causing gaps to revert as liquidity rebalances and institutional algos fade the initial imbalance.

## Mechanism

At 09:30 ET, if SPY gaps up (open > prior day’s close) and gap size (open‑prior close) is between 0.2× and 0.8× the 20‑day ATR, wait until 10:30 ET. If price has retraced to fill ≥50% of the gap (price ≤ open – 0.5×gap) and the 5‑min bar closes bullish (close > open) with volume ≥ its 20‑day average volume, enter long at the bar’s close. Exit: initial stop at the low of the entry bar; primary target is 1:1 risk-reward (gap fill to prior close). If price achieves 75% gap fill, move stop to break-even and trail the runner with 1.5×ATR. Only trade when VIX < 12 and between 09:30‑11:00 ET; skip known news events via external filter.
